question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. For no________ reason, the train suddenly stopped, and the passengers went into a state of panic.
solution:
The correct answer is '**apparent**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**apparent**" means clearly visible or understood; obvious. (स्पष्ट)
 
• In the given context, the word "apparent" correctly describes the lack of a visible reason for the train stopping.
 
• The other options: "**gaudy**," "**taken**," and "**florid**" do not fit the context appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *For no apparent__ reason, the train suddenly stopped, and the passengers went into a state of panic.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Gaudy (भड़कीला)**: means extravagantly bright or showy, typically so as to be tasteless.
 
• **Taken (लिया हुआ)**: means to have possession of something.
 
• **Florid (सजीव)**: means having a red or flushed complexion; elaborately or excessively intricate or complicated.
